title: The Tale of the Sixth Brother, the Cropped of Lips

paragraphs.en: The Sixth Brother, who had once been wealthy but later impoverished, ventured out one day in search of food. He arrived at a grand house guarded by attendants and servants. Upon asking about the owner, he was told it was part of the Barmaki family's estate.
paragraphs.zh: 从前富裕后来家道中落的第六兄弟外出寻觅食物，来到了一座宏伟的府邸前，守卫着的仆从和侍卫将他挡在了外面。当他询问府邸主人时，被告知这属于巴尔马基家族的产业。

paragraphs.en: Inside, the brother found himself in an opulent mansion adorned with carpets and curtains, surrounded by a beautiful garden unlike any he had seen before. Confused, he approached a reception room and entered to find a handsome man with a fine beard at the end. The man welcomed him warmly, enquired about his health, and learned of his hunger.
paragraphs.zh: Inside，六弟发现自己置身于一座富丽堂皇的府邸中，地毯和帷幔装饰一新，四周环绕着一个他从未见过的美丽花园。他感到有些困惑，便走近一间接待室，推门而入，只见一位留着精致胡须的英俊男子正坐在那里。那男子热情地迎接了他，关切地询问他的身体状况，并得知他还饿着肚子。

paragraphs.en: Moved by my brother's plight, the man expressed great sadness, tore his clothes, and exclaimed that it was intolerable for someone to be hungry in such a city. He promised all the best and invited my brother to dine with him. However, my brother politely declined, stating he could not wait due to his extreme hunger.
paragraphs.zh: 被哥哥的困境触动，那人显得非常悲痛，扯下衣襟，大声喊道：“在这个城里竟然还有人挨饿，这简直无法忍受！”他许下了最好的承诺，并邀请哥哥共进晚餐。然而，哥哥礼貌地谢绝了，说他实在等不及了，因为饥饿难耐。

paragraphs.en: The man called out, "Boy, bring the ewer and basin for washing hands." He then instructed my brother, "Go ahead and wash your hands," but my brother saw no ewer or basin. The host gestured as if washing his own hands.
paragraphs.zh: 那人喊道：“小哥儿，拿水盆和洗漱盂来。”随后他对我的兄长说：“你先去洗手吧。”但我的兄长并未看到水盆和洗漱盂。只见主人摆出自己正在洗手的样子。

paragraphs.en: Next, he ordered, "Bring the table," waving his hand. Again, my brother saw nothing, but the host said, "Eat, don’t be bashful." He mimicked eating with his hand and continued, "By my life, have more; I know how famished you are."
paragraphs.zh: 接着，他吩咐道：“把桌子端上来。”说着挥了挥手。我的哥哥依旧什么也没看见，但主人说道：“吃吧，别客气。”他假装用餐的手比划着，继续说道：“天哪，再多吃点；我知道你饿坏了。”

paragraphs.en: My brother began to mimic eating as well, thinking the man enjoyed playing tricks on people. He replied, "My lord, never in my life have I seen whiter or better-tasting bread." The host responded, "I paid five hundred dinars for the slave-girl who baked it for me."
paragraphs.zh: 我的哥哥也开始学着吃东西，以为那人大概是在和人开玩笑。他说道：“大人，我这一辈子都没吃过这么白、这么好吃的面包。”主人回答道：“为了让她给我烤面包，我花了五百第纳尔。”

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent. Dinarzad said, "Sister, what an amusing and entertaining story!" Shahrazad replied, "What is this compared to what I shall tell you tomorrow night if the king spares me and lets me live?"
paragraphs.zh: 清晨来临，沙赫拉兹默不作声。丁纳札德说道：“姐姐，这故事真是妙趣横生、引人入胜！”沙赫拉兹达回应道：“比起我明天晚上要讲的故事，这又算得了什么？如果国王饶恕了我，让我继续活下去的话。”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began: "I heard, O happy King, that the tailor told the king of China that the barber told the guests that he said to the caliph."
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉罕开始讲述：“幸福的国王啊，我听说裁缝告诉中国国王，理发师告诉宾客们，他说给哈里发听的。”

paragraphs.en: The host called out, "Boy, bring the meat porridge first, and don't spare the butter." He then addressed my brother: "My guest, by God, have you seen a better porridge? Eat without being bashful."
paragraphs.zh: 主人喊道：“小哥儿，先上来肉粥，并且别吝啬黄油。”随后他对我的哥哥说道：“这位客官，老天作证，你尝过的粥有比这更好的吗？尽管吃，不要客气。”

paragraphs.en: The host continued to call for dishes, inviting my brother to eat despite none appearing. "Bring us the fatted goose stew in vinegar sauce," he cried out again. "Eat these chickens fattened on pistachio nuts; they are unlike anything you've tasted before," he said.
paragraphs.zh: 主人继续叫人上菜，尽管什么都没有上来，还是邀请我哥哥品尝。“快把醋烧肥鹅端上来！”他再次喊道。“尝尝这些用杏仁喂大的鸡吧；它们的味道你肯定从未体验过。”他说。

paragraphs.en: My brother responded, "My lord, they are indeed delicious."
paragraphs.zh: 我的兄弟回答说：“大人，确实很好吃。”

paragraphs.en: The host then tried to feed my brother himself, while my brother, starving, longed for plain barley bread. The host ordered fried meats and asked, "Have you ever tasted anything more delicious than the seasoning of these dishes? Have some more."
paragraphs.zh: 主人随后亲自给哥哥夹菜，而哥哥早已饿得前胸贴后背，只巴望着普通的燕麦面包。主人吩咐上了一盘炸肉，问道：“你尝过比这菜肴调料更美味的东西吗？再吃点吧。”

paragraphs.en: When my brother said he had eaten enough, the host insisted, "Take this dish away and bring the sweets." He urged my brother to eat almond conserve and fritters, claiming they were dripping with syrup. My brother replied, "My lord, may I never lose you," and inquired about the musk content in the fritters.
paragraphs.zh: 当我哥哥表示已经吃饱时，主人坚持道：“把这道菜撤走，换上甜点。”他催促我的哥哥品尝杏仁糖和油炸糕，并声称这些食物浸满了蜜汁。我哥哥回答说：“大人，但愿我永远不失去您。”然后他又询问油炸糕里含有多少麝香。

paragraphs.en: The host responded, "It is my custom to make them this way," while my brother continued to move his jaws. Finally, the host called for almond jelly, saying, "Eat and don't be bashful." My brother replied, "I am full; I can eat no more."
paragraphs.zh: 主人回答说：“我一向都是这样做的。”说着，他继续给哥哥夹菜。最后，主人叫来了一盘杏糕，说道：“吃吧，别客气。”哥哥回应道：“我已经吃饱了，不能再吃了。”

paragraphs.en: The host invited my brother with a cup of wine, saying, "Drink and enjoy." My brother pretended drunkenness but struck the host twice on the neck. The host laughed and praised him, admitting his wit.
paragraphs.zh: 主人端来一杯酒，说：“喝吧，享受一下。”我哥哥装作醉态，却在主人的脖子上连击两掌。主人笑着称赞他，承认他的机智。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad paused her tale. Dinarzad exclaimed, "What an amusing story!" Shahrazad replied, "Wait until tomorrow night when I have more to tell if you are spared."
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹暂停了她的讲述。丁纳札德脱口而出：“真是个有趣的故事！”沙赫拉兹adeon答道：“如果你能活到明天晚上，我自然会有更多故事奉上。”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德开口说道：

paragraphs.en: O King, the tailor told the king of China that the barber said to his guests about what he had told the caliph.
paragraphs.zh: 国王啊，裁缝将理发师对客人说的话告诉了中国国王，而理发师则是从哈里发那里听说的。

paragraphs.en: The host forgave my brother and invited him to dine. They feasted for ten days, with young women playing music and singing. The host treated my brother like a brother and gave him a robe.
paragraphs.zh: 主人原谅了我哥哥，请他共进晚餐。他们欢宴了十天，期间有年轻女子奏乐唱歌。主人待我哥哥如亲兄弟一般，并送给他一件袍子。

paragraphs.en: Afterward, the Barmaki entrusted his affairs to my brother, who managed them for twenty years. However, when the man died, the king seized all his property, leaving my brother destitute.
paragraphs.zh: 后来，巴尔卡米将所有事务交由我哥哥打理，一共有二十年之久。然而，当那人去世后，国王却乘机没收了他的全部财产，致使我的哥哥陷入了贫困。

paragraphs.en: My brother wandered alone until bedouins captured him. They demanded ransom but he had none. The captor beat him and cut off his lips, still seeking payment.
paragraphs.zh: 我的兄弟独自流浪，最终被游牧民捉住了。他们索要赎金，但他一无所有。那个俘虏痛打了他，并割掉了他的嘴唇，依然在寻找赔偿。

paragraphs.en: His wife tried to seduce my brother, but he refused. One day, she succeeded, and when the husband found them together, he cut off my brother’s male organ.
paragraphs.zh: 他的妻子试图引诱我的哥哥，但他拒绝了。有一天，她得逞了，当丈夫发现他们在一起时，竟割去了我哥哥的阳具。

paragraphs.en: The bedouin then cast my brother on a camel by a hillside. Travelers recognized him and provided food and drink. I found him, brought him back to Baghdad, and gave him an allowance.
paragraphs.zh: 贝都因人随后将我哥哥安置在山脚下的一头骆驼上。过往的旅人认出了他，给了他食物和水。我找到了他，把他带回了巴格达，并给他提供了一笔生活费。

paragraphs.en: Here I stand before you, O Commander of the Faithful, to inform you about the six brothers I support.
paragraphs.zh: 我就站在这里，尊敬的哈里发大人，来向您汇报我支持的六位兄弟的情况。

paragraphs.en: The caliph laughed after hearing my brothers' adventures and told me to leave the city. He banished me, and I wandered until another caliph took power. Returning to Baghdad, I found my brothers dead.
paragraphs.zh: 听了哥哥们的冒险经历后，哈里发笑了一声，让我离开这座城市。他将我放逐，我四处流浪，直到另一位哈里发掌权。回到巴格达时，我发现我的哥哥们已经去世。

paragraphs.en: A young man benefited greatly from me but fled when he could have repaid me. I met him again here, where he falsely accused me of being a talkative liar.
paragraphs.zh: 一个年轻人曾因我而受益良多，却在我本可以得到回报时逃之夭夭。在这里我又碰到了他，他竟诬蔑我是爱嚼舌头的骗子。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad's time was up as morning approached. Dinarzad praised her sister's story and asked for another the next night if she survived. Shahrazad agreed, promising to tell more tales.
paragraphs.zh: 天色渐亮，沙赫拉兹的故事时间到了。迪纳尔扎德称赞了姐姐的故事，并请求如果她能熬过今晚，明天晚上再讲一个。沙赫拉兹erset下诺言，答应会讲述更多的故事。

paragraphs.en: The following night, Dinarzad urged Shahrazad to continue her tale about the roguish hunchback. The king requested the continuation of that story as well.
paragraphs.zh: 当晚，迪纳兹催促沙赫拉扎德继续讲述那个机灵的驼背的故事。国王也要求她继续讲下去。

paragraphs.en: Yesterday, after hearing the barber's tale and realizing his guilt towards a young man, we bound and locked him up. My wife complained that I had been out all day while she stayed home. We went out for the evening, but on our return, we found the hunchback drunk at our doorstep.
paragraphs.zh: 昨天，听完了理发师的故事并意识到自己对一个年轻人有所亏欠后，我们把他绑了起来，关进了屋子里。我妻子抱怨说整天我自己在外忙，她却守在家里。于是我们出去度了个晚上的时光，可当我们回家时，却发现那个驼背乞丐醉倒在了家门口。

paragraphs.en: Inviting him in, we ate fish together. Just as we finished, I took the last piece with a bone and forced it into his mouth, causing him to choke. He died from the obstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 请他进屋，我们一起吃了鱼。就在快要吃完的时候，我夹起最后一块带刺的鱼肉，硬塞进了他的嘴里，结果让他呛住了。由于鱼刺阻塞，他最终窒息而死。

paragraphs.en: I disposed of his body by bringing it to a Jewish physician, who then passed it on to the steward, who eventually handed it over to a Christian broker.
paragraphs.zh: 我把他的尸体交给了一位犹太医生处理，随后那位医生转交给了管家，最终由一名基督教商人接手。

paragraphs.en: Isn't this adventure more thrilling than the hunchback's story?
paragraphs.zh: 这冒险可比驼背的故事刺激多了。

paragraphs.en: When the Chinese king heard the tailor's tale about the young man and the meddlesome barber, he was delighted. He ordered one of his chamberlains to fetch the silent barber from his confinement. The king wanted to see him and hear his story for himself before burying the hunchback, who had been dead since the previous evening.
paragraphs.zh: 当中国国王听了裁缝讲述的那个年轻人和多管闲事的理发师的故事后，他非常高兴。他命令一名近臣将那个哑巴理发师从监禁中带出来相见，并亲自听他说说这段故事。因为驼背人在前一晚就已经去世了，国王打算在埋葬他之前先见个面。

paragraphs.en: The chamberlain returned with a very old man, over ninety years old, with white hair and eyebrows, floppy ears, and a long nose. The king laughed at his appearance and asked the barber to tell them one of his tales. Instead, the barber questioned why he was there, asking if this gathering involved Christians, Jews, Muslims, or even the dead hunchback.
paragraphs.zh: 太监领进一位年逾九旬的老者，满头白发，眉毛花白，双耳下垂，鼻梁挺直。国王见状不禁笑出声来，让理发师讲个故事给他们听。不料理发师反问道，他为何在此现身，还问这聚会是否涉及基督徒、犹太人、穆斯林，甚至那个已故的驼背。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad fell silent as morning approached. Dinarzad remarked, "Sister, what a strange and entertaining story!" Shahrazad replied, "This is nothing compared to what I will tell you tomorrow night if the king spares me."
paragraphs.zh: 天色渐亮，莎赫拉兹默不作声。丁纳兹说道：“姐姐，这个故事真是既奇异又有趣！”莎赫拉兹 aden答道：“比起我明天晚上要告诉你的故事来，这根本不算什么。”

paragraphs.en: The king of China summoned the barber, who was told the tale of the hunchback. Upon hearing it, the barber laughed loudly, then applied an ointment to the hunchback's neck and used tweezers to extract a piece of fish with a bone from his throat. The hunchback sneezed and stood up, amazed.
paragraphs.zh: 中国国王召见了理发师，将驼背的故事告诉他。理发师听后不禁大笑，随后在驼背的脖子上涂抹了一种药膏，并用镊子从他的喉咙里夹出一块带骨头的鱼肉。驼背打了个喷嚏，惊讶地站了起来。

paragraphs.en: The king and others marveled at this miraculous recovery. The king ordered the story recorded and rewarded the steward, tailor, Christian, and Jew. He also honored the barber with a robe and regular allowance, making him his companion until their deaths.
paragraphs.zh: 国王和其他人对这一奇迹般的康复赞叹不已。国王下令将此事记录下来，并奖赏了管家、裁缝、克里斯蒂安和犹太人。他还特意为理发师赐予了一件礼服和定期的津贴，让他成为自己终生的朋友直至二人去世。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad paused her storytelling as morning approached. Dinarzad praised the tale, and Shahrazad promised an even more entertaining one the next night: the story of Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn-Tahir al-’Attar and Nur al-Din Ali ibn-Bakkar, along with their encounter with a caliph's slave-girl named Shams al-Nahar.
paragraphs.zh: 随着晨光渐近，沙赫拉兹阿德暂停了讲述。丁纳兹阿德称赞起这个故事，沙赫拉兹阿德则承诺在下一个夜晚带来更加精彩的故事：关于阿布·阿哈桑阿里·本-塔伊尔·阿特塔尔和努尔·阿丁阿里·本-巴卡尔及其与一名叫夏姆斯·纳哈尔的哈里发女奴相遇的故事。

paragraphs.en: The next evening, Dinarzad said to her sister Shahrazad, "Sister, if you're not sleepy, tell us one of your charming tales to pass the time." King Shahrayar added, "Let it be about Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn-Tahir al-’Attar and Nur al-Din Ali ibn-Bakkar and their encounter with Shams al-Nahar." Shahrazad replied, "With pleasure."
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，迪纳兹达对她的妹妹沙赫拉札德说：“ sister，如果你不困的话，给我们讲一个动听的故事打发时间吧。”国王沙赫里亚尔补充道：“最好是关于阿布·阿哈桑阿里·本-塔伊尔·阿特尔和努尔·丁阿里·本-巴卡尔以及他们与白天之星的相遇的故事。”沙赫拉札德回答说：“我乐意这样做。”
